title: Public Education on Proper Use of Hospital A&E Departments and Promotion of Remote Care
what_it_is: Public Education on Proper Use of Hospital A&E Departments and Promotion of Remote Care

sections.label: Healthier SG and urgent care
sections.summary: All 1,000 Healthier SG GP clinics are on the GPFirst programme, an Urgent Care Centre was set up in the north, and hospitals encourage telemedicine use.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: With the implementation of Healthier SG, all 1,000 Healthier SG general practitioner (GP) clinics are on board the GPFirst programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We have also set up an Urgent Care Centre in the north, to ease the A&E cases at Khoo Teck Puat Hospital.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Our hospitals are encouraging the greater use of telemedicine, including a helpline to advise people where to seek treatment.

sections.label: Urgent care centre pilot details
sections.summary: Admiralty and NUH Children's urgent care centres have set operating hours, patient numbers for 2022, and can perform blood tests, X-rays, plaster casts and intravenous fluids.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: As far as urgent care centres are concerned, I thank him for the question.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We are piloting the urgent care centre at Admiralty.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: It is opened daily, including public holidays, from 8.00 am to 11.00 pm.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: There is another urgent care centre at the National University Hospital (NUH) Children's Urgent Care Clinic @ Bukit Panjang for the paediatric population opened daily from 2.00 pm to 10.00 pm.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: At Admiralty, they have seen over 16,000 patients in 2022; and at the NUH clinic, 21,900 patients in 2022.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Other than the usual conditions that primary care physicians will be managing, the urgent care centres can also perform simple blood tests and X-rays onsite and provide services that you do not usually see at most GPs, such as plaster casts for minor fractures and sometimes, intravenous fluids for short periods with observation.
